issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame declares format='RGB' but image.tobytes() returns raw bytes in PIL's actual mode (RGBA/P/L/etc.)
issues.detail: Image.open() on Gemini inline_data may decode to RGBA, P, L, CMYK, or other modes depending on the source format. The code calls image.tobytes() without converting and hardcodes format='RGB', so any non-RGB output produces a byte buffer whose length and layout disagree with the declared format. Downstream consumers will render garbled pixels, get wrong colors, or fail on size mismatch (W*H*4 vs W*H*3). Fix with image.convert('RGB').tobytes() before constructing the frame, or pass the actual mode through.

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time mutates third-party private global state unconditionally
issues.detail: The line genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 executes at module import as an unconditional side effect, reaching into a leading-underscore (private) submodule of google-genai. The author labels it a 'Temporary hack' in the code itself. This poisons global library state for every consumer of google-genai in the process, will silently break when the SDK refactors _api_client, and is amplified by the simultaneous widening of the google-genai version range. Either use a supported public API, scope the override to a client instance, or at minimum guard with hasattr, justify the 5 MiB bound, and link a tracking issue.

issues.description: Silent default-model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a behavior break for every caller relying on the default
issues.detail: Changing the GoogleLLMService constructor default alters cost, latency, token accounting, and thinking-budget behavior (via the new _maybe_unset_thinking_budget logic) for every existing caller who did not pin a model. The CHANGELOG records this only under 'Changed' as a one-liner, which under-signals the substitution risk. This is also a separable concern from the image-generation feature and should be split into its own PR/changelog entry, or at minimum emit a deprecation warning and document the delta loudly.

issues.description: Substring match 'image' in self._model_name is a fragile, stringly-typed capability check
issues.detail: _maybe_unset_thinking_budget uses `if "image" in self._model_name` as a stand-in for a real capability predicate. It will false-positive on future models whose names contain 'image' for unrelated reasons (e.g. gemini-2.6-pro-imagen-eval) and miss image-capable models named differently. Lift this into a named predicate (e.g. _model_supports_image_output() or a capability table/enum) used consistently by both the thinking-budget branch and the inline_data emission branch.

issues.description: No tests cover the new image-decoding branch or thinking-budget logic
issues.detail: A new elif arm in _process_context opens bytes with PIL, constructs a frame, and pushes it downstream, and a new branch was added in _maybe_unset_thinking_budget — neither has unit-test coverage. The example script requires a live API key and is not a test. A unit test feeding a fake Part with inline_data.data set to a known PNG/JPEG (including non-RGB modes) and asserting frame size/format would have caught the RGB-mode bug above. Without it, regressions in this path ship unnoticed.

issues.description: Image branch has no error handling and no documented postconditions (ordering, multi-image, decode failure)
issues.detail: The new `elif part.inline_data and part.inline_data.data:` branch wraps Image.open without try/except — a malformed payload raises PIL.UnidentifiedImageError and aborts the whole turn. There is no size cap, no mime-type check (any inline_data is assumed to be an image), and no stated contract for ordering relative to LLMTextFrame, multi-image responses, inclusion in assistant context/history, or LLM metrics. Wrap decode in try/except with logged-skip semantics, check inline_data.mime_type starts with 'image/', and add a docstring stating the postconditions of this branch.

issues.description: Three logically independent changes squashed into one PR
issues.detail: The diff bundles (1) image-output handling, (2) default-model bump, and (3) widening of google-* dependency specifiers from `~=` to `>=,<major`. Each has different blast radius and different reasons to revert. Split into separate commits/PRs so each has its own changelog entry and revert point.

issues.description: Dependency specifier widened from `~=1.24.0` to `>=1.41.0,<2` without justification or test-matrix evidence
issues.detail: Moving google-genai (and the speech/tts packages) from compatible-release to a broad `>=,<major` range trades reproducibility for flexibility. Combined with the genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE monkey-patch, any minor release inside [1.41, 2) can quietly remove the patched attribute. Pin closer to what was actually tested, or at minimum document the test matrix and rationale in the PR description.

issues.description: Stray blank line added in __init__ with no semantic content
issues.detail: An empty line was inserted between `self._http_options = http_options` and `self._create_client(...)`. Diff noise that will live in blame forever; drop it.

issues.description: Example file has misleading/inconsistent header content
issues.detail: The example's docstring conflates Gemini with Google Cloud STT/TTS, the headline image-generation feature isn't called out despite the filename, the copyright header reads '2024-2025' on a brand-new 2026 file, and required env vars (GOOGLE_TEST_CREDENTIALS) aren't documented alongside GOOGLE_API_KEY. Easy fixes; matters because this is the canonical onboarding artifact for the feature.

issues.description: Part-dispatch cascade in _process_context wants to be a small filter/dispatch table
issues.detail: _process_context walks candidates -> content.parts and branches on text / function_call / inline_data with growing elif arms. Each part type is a stateless transform from a Gemini Part into an outbound Frame. A small dispatch table or part-to-frame functions would make each new modality (image, audio, video) a one-line addition instead of another elif in a growing pyramid.

synthesis.summary: Consensus: NEEDS-WORK. The panel unanimously identifies two P0 defects. First, the new image branch constructs OutputImageRawFrame with image.tobytes() and a hardcoded format='RGB' without converting the PIL image's mode, silently corrupting any non-RGB output (RGBA PNGs, palette images, etc.). Second, the module mutates genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time — a private third-party attribute, labeled 'Temporary hack' in the code itself — which poisons global SDK state for every consumer in the process and is amplified by the simultaneous widening of the google-genai version range. Beyond those, the default model is silently bumped from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash (a behavior/cost change for every existing caller), image-capability detection is a substring match instead of a named predicate, the new branch has no tests and no error handling for decode failures or non-image MIME types, and three logically independent changes (feature, default bump, dependency widening) are squashed into one PR. Path to acceptance: convert pixel data to the declared mode, scope or remove the buffer-size mutation, split the model and dependency changes out, replace the substring guard with an explicit capability predicate, and add unit coverage for the inline-data branch.
